sources.name: Malcolm (cisagov)
sources.description: Full-featured, open source network traffic analysis tool suite capable of processing and presenting PCAP files, Zeek logs, and Suricata alerts. Used as the upstream base for KALINALYSIS infrastructure components.

sources.name: Kali Purple
sources.description: The official Kali Purple edition repository — Kali Linux's defensive security and SOC-in-a-box distribution built on top of standard Kali. Contains configuration scripts, detection tooling, and SOC framework integrations.

sources.name: kalitorify
sources.description: Shell script to make Kali Linux transparent proxy through the Tor network. Routes all outgoing traffic through Tor for anonymity during red team assessments.

sources.name: ERR0RS-Ultimate
sources.description: Multi-tool offensive security framework providing enumeration, exploitation helpers, and post-exploitation modules consolidated into a single menu-driven interface.

sources.name: Kali Linux Cheatsheet
sources.description: Comprehensive Kali Linux command-line cheatsheet covering tools across all major categories: information gathering, vulnerability analysis, web application testing, password cracking, wireless, and exploitation.

sources.name: h4cker
sources.description: Massive collection of hacking and CTF resources compiled by Omar Santos. Covers ethical hacking, CTF walkthroughs, exploit development, forensics, malware analysis, and security research references.

sources.name: theHarvester
sources.description: OSINT tool for gathering emails, subdomains, hosts, employee names, open ports, and banners from different public sources. Essential for early-phase recon in penetration testing engagements.

sources.name: Centipede
sources.description: Internal automation tooling for KALINALYSIS workflows. Provides orchestration helpers, data pipeline utilities, and integration glue for combining outputs from multiple security tools.

sources.name: YellowKey
sources.description: Key and credential management utilities for lab environments. Provides helpers for rotating secrets, generating SSH/GPG keys in bulk, and managing local Keycloak realm credentials.
